summary: Comprehensive redesign plan for the Admin Edit Product page. Includes sticky top action bar, breadcrumb navigation with one-click Product ID copy, live customer product preview link, status toggle (Active/Paused/Draft), modernized tab navigation with dynamic item counters, floating unsaved changes bar, reorganized accordion sections, quick-jump anchor menu, live multi-currency price preview, 1-click product cloning, and Google SERP SEO/meta preview.
